title: Revamp the calendar app
body: Please apple, for the love of god. At least make the app 1/3 useful as the google calendars app. I love how the icon of the app changes as the day changes, so I want to use it as my default calendar, but it lacks even the most fundamental features of calendar app in today’s standards. If you are unable to do it in single update, I don’t care if you just upgrade the calendar app in IOS16, just do it. Also bring apple news and fitness to Mongolia please.
author: bminleg
